result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: CGL of USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O of USD 2M, cyber/privacy of USD 5M for IBM as a data-processing vendor, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It preserves the existing risk-of-loss allocation and is professionally drafted. However, requiring all coverage to continue for one year after the term and specifying that it be maintained at IBM’s expense go beyond the supplied playbook and are not necessary to achieve it; the post-term requirement is also awkward as applied to occurrence-based CGL and workers’ compensation coverage.
